body.name: Valve body
body.does: Holds the pressure and the flow's way: in at one flange, under the seat ring, up through it and out at the other. It stays bolted between its pipe flanges when the valve is opened.

seat_ring.name: Seat ring
seat_ring.does: The ring the plug closes on: the gap between them sets the flow. Held down in the body by the cage, on its gasket.
seat_ring.material: Stainless steel, hardened at the seat

cage.name: Cage
cage.does: Guides the plug as it moves and holds the seat ring down; the flow passes through its windows, whose shape gives the valve its characteristic.

plug_stem.name: Valve plug and stem
plug_stem.does: The plug is the closure member: it rises off the seat ring to open the valve. Its stem, pinned to it, leaves the body through the bonnet's packing.

bonnet.name: Bonnet
bonnet.does: Closes the body over the trim, holds the cage down on its gasket and carries the packing box and the actuator's yoke.

packing.name: Packing, follower and packing flange
packing.does: Rings of PTFE or graphite squeezed round the stem by the follower under the packing flange, so the process cannot leak along the stem.
packing.material: PTFE or graphite rings, stainless steel follower and flange

yoke.name: Yoke
yoke.does: The actuator's frame, clamped to the bonnet by the yoke locknut; the stem connector and the travel scale are in its window.

stem_connector.name: Stem connector and travel indicator
stem_connector.does: Clamps the valve stem to the actuator stem; its indicator disk shows the travel against the yoke's scale.

lower_casing.name: Lower diaphragm casing
lower_casing.does: The lower half of the casing round the diaphragm, bolted to the yoke; the actuator stem passes through its middle.

upper_casing.name: Upper diaphragm casing
upper_casing.does: The upper half: the air from the positioner fills it above the diaphragm and pushes the stem down.

diaphragm.name: Diaphragm
diaphragm.does: A rubber sheet that turns the air's pressure into a force on the diaphragm head.

actuator_stem.name: Actuator stem and diaphragm head
actuator_stem.does: The diaphragm head (a plate under the diaphragm) on the actuator stem: the air pushes it down, the spring back up.

spring.name: Actuator spring
spring.does: Pushes the diaphragm head up against the air: when the air goes, the spring lifts the stem and the valve fails open.

positioner.name: Positioner
positioner.does: Compares the 4-20 mA demand with the stem's travel (a magnet on the stem connector) and sends air to the actuator until they agree.

tubing.name: Actuator tubing
tubing.does: Carries the positioner's output air to the actuator's casing.

text: The body stays bolted between its pipe flanges.
why: The trim, the bonnet and the actuator all come out upwards, without disturbing the pipes.

text: Put a new seat ring gasket and the seat ring into the body.
needs: body
The seat ring goes into the body: it is there first.
The body stays on its pipes.

text: Set the cage, with its gasket, on the seat ring.
needs: seat_ring
The cage stands on the seat ring: fit the seat ring first.
Lift the cage out before the seat ring.

text: Lower the plug and stem into the cage until the plug rests on the seat ring.
why: The plug and the stem are pinned together: they are changed as one.
needs: cage
The plug is guided in the cage: fit the cage first.
Take the plug and stem out before the cage.

text: Fit a new bonnet gasket and lower the bonnet over the stem onto the body.
needs: plug_stem
The bonnet goes on over the stem: put the plug and stem in first.
Lift the bonnet off before the plug and stem come out.
cage
The bonnet holds the cage down: fit the cage first.
Lift the bonnet off before the cage comes out.

text: Tighten the bonnet nuts evenly, crosswise.
needs: bonnet
The nuts hold the bonnet down: set it on first.
Take the bonnet nuts off before the bonnet is lifted.

text: Slide the packing rings over the stem into the bonnet, then the follower and the packing flange, and tighten its nuts.
needs: bonnet
The packing goes into the bonnet's packing box: fit the bonnet first.
Take the packing out before the bonnet comes off.

text: Set the actuator's yoke over the stem onto the bonnet and tighten the yoke locknut.
why: In the shop the actuator (the yoke with its casing, diaphragm, stem and spring) is put together on the bench and set on the valve whole; the steps here fit each part on the yoke in its place, and the "taken apart" view shows the actuator lifting off whole.
needs: packing
Fit the packing before the actuator goes on.
Take the actuator off before the packing comes out.
bonnet_bolts
The yoke sits on the bonnet: bolt the bonnet down first.
Take the actuator off before the bonnet nuts.

text: Bolt the lower diaphragm casing to the yoke, the actuator stem's seal bushing in its middle.
needs: yoke
The lower casing sits on the yoke: fit the yoke first.
Take the lower casing off before the yoke.

text: Put the spring in, under where the diaphragm head will sit.
why: In the 667 the spring sits in the yoke under the lower casing, put in from below with its adjuster and, taking apart, relieved and taken out first; drawn here inside the lower casing, it comes out after the diaphragm head.
needs: lower_casing
The spring sits in the actuator: fit the lower casing first.
Take the spring out before the lower casing.

text: Put the actuator stem, with its diaphragm head, down through the spring and the lower casing.
needs: spring
The diaphragm head rests on the spring: put the spring in first.
Take the stem and its head out before the spring.

text: Lay the diaphragm on the diaphragm head, its edge over the lower casing's flange.
needs: actuator_stem
The diaphragm lies on its head: put the stem and head in first.
Lift the diaphragm off before the stem and its head.

text: Set the upper casing on the diaphragm.
needs: diaphragm
The upper casing closes over the diaphragm: lay it first.
Lift the upper casing off before the diaphragm.

text: Fit the casing cap screws and nuts and tighten them crosswise, a little at a time.
needs: upper_casing
The cap screws hold the upper casing: set it on first.
Take the cap screws out before the upper casing is lifted.

text: With the plug on its seat, bring the actuator stem down to the valve stem and clamp them together in the stem connector; set the travel indicator to the scale.
why: Taking apart, the spring is relieved before the stem connector is undone: never part it while the spring pushes on it.
needs: casing_bolts
Join the stems when the actuator is bolted together.
Separate the stem connector before the actuator's casing comes apart.
plug_stem
The connector clamps the valve stem: put the plug and stem in first.
Separate the stem connector before the plug and stem come out.
actuator_stem
The connector clamps the actuator stem: put it in first.
Separate the stem connector before the actuator stem comes out.

text: Mount the positioner on the yoke, its feedback magnet on the stem connector.
needs: stem_connector
The positioner reads the travel from the stem connector: fit it first.
Take the positioner off before the stem connector.

text: Connect the tubing from the positioner's output to the upper casing.
why: Shut off and vent the air supply before disconnecting anything.
needs: positioner
The tubing runs from the positioner: mount it first.
Disconnect the tubing first.
upper_casing
The tubing goes to the upper casing: fit it first.
Disconnect the tubing before the upper casing comes off.
